'''Lamar the Fifth''', also known as the '''Mad Master Lamar the Fifth''', was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who passed away sometime before the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but he endured as a tortured [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] until a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Ngani Zho]] helped his spirit find peace and become one with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Lost Suns" />
